description: Amazon's Black Friday Week 2026 runs 19–30 November. Key dates, whether you need Prime, last year's best prices and Christmas returns.
intro:
**Amazon's Black Friday Week 2026 runs from Thursday 19 November to Cyber Monday, 30 November.** Amazon confirmed the dates on its UK news site on 10 November, and deals on its own devices, such as Kindle, Echo and Fire TV, start a few days earlier, on 16 November.

You don't need Prime for most of the deals, but members get extra 'Epic Prime Deals', so if you're not a member, the free trial is worth starting on 19 November. Amazon devices are mostly still at full price, so wait for the 16th. Last checked: 11 November 2026.

body:
## When does Amazon Black Friday 2026 start?

**Thursday 19 November 2026.** Amazon's UK news site, updated on 10 November, says Black Friday Week runs from **19 to 30 November**, 12 days ending on Cyber Monday. The key dates:

- **16 November:** deals on Amazon devices (Kindle, Echo, Fire TV, Ring, Blink) begin.
- **18 November:** Alexa tablet deals begin.
- **19 November:** Black Friday Week starts for everything else.
- **27 November:** Black Friday.
- **30 November:** Cyber Monday, the last day.

Which? also reports early offers on everyday essentials, beauty and pet items from 10 November, with more categories added on 13 and 16 November. Amazon itself only confirms the device date, so treat those as early extras rather than the main event. The pattern matches the last two years: 2024 ran from 21 November to 2 December, and 2025 from 20 November to 1 December. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) tracks every retailer's dates.

## Do you need Prime for Amazon Black Friday deals?

Mostly not. Amazon says you don't need Prime to shop its Black Friday deals, and Lightning Deals are only Prime-only during Prime Day and Prime Big Deal Days (the October 2026 one ran on 6 and 7 October). Prime does help with:

- **Free fast delivery.** Useful if your basket is small or you're cutting it fine for Christmas.
- **Member-only extras.** In 2025 these included grocery vouchers for new customers at Morrisons, Iceland and Co-op on Amazon.
- **Prime Video, Amazon Music and Prime Reading** over the holidays.

Prime costs £8.99 a month or £95 a year, and students and 18 to 24-year-olds pay £4.49 a month or £47.49 a year. If you're not a member, the [30-day Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) is worth starting on the day the sale opens, not before, so it covers Black Friday, Cyber Monday and early-December Christmas orders. Our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains the timing and how to cancel.

## What's on at Amazon right now

The main sale starts on 19 November, but a few Amazon devices are already cut. The **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition** was £139.99 on 10 November, down from £229.99 and the lowest price it has been, according to TechRadar. Most other Amazon devices, including Echo and Fire TV, were still at full price, so hold off until device deals begin on 16 November. Prime members also get 'Epic Prime Deals' during the event, with two new batches of deals each day.

## Last year's Amazon Black Friday prices

These are **2025 Black Friday prices**, not current ones. They're a good guide to what Amazon is likely to charge again:

- **Kindle (2024, with ads):** £69.99
- **Kindle Paperwhite (2024, with ads):** £134.99
- **Echo Dot:** about £30
- **Fire TV Stick 4K:** about £25
- **Ring Battery Video Doorbell:** about £40
- **Kindle Scribe:** about £259
- **Fire TV Omni QLED 50in:** about £300

If an Amazon device is above these figures in the week of Black Friday, it's probably worth waiting. Amazon refreshed its Kindles this autumn, so see our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/) for which model to buy.

## How to check an Amazon deal is real

Amazon's 'was' prices and 'RRP' labels don't always reflect what an item has actually sold for. Before you buy:

1. **Check the price history.** Paste the Amazon link into [CamelCamelCamel](https://uk.camelcamelcamel.com/) or Keepa. Both chart Amazon's own price over months, so you can see whether today's price is a real low.
2. **Set an alert.** CamelCamelCamel will email you when a product drops below a price you choose, so you don't have to keep checking.
3. **Check who's selling it.** 'Sold by Amazon' or the brand's own store is safest. Be wary of marketplace sellers with big discounts on brands you've never heard of.
4. **Compare one other shop.** Argos, Currys and John Lewis often match Amazon during Black Friday, and they have their own returns windows.

## Returns over Christmas

Amazon's normal returns window is 30 days from delivery. For the 2025 season, the UK extension let you return most items bought between **1 November and 25 December 2025** until **31 January 2026**, or 30 days from delivery if that was later. In October 2026 Amazon said its US extension will be repeated for 2026, but it hadn't confirmed UK terms when we checked. Until it does, assume a similar window but don't rely on it for anything you might want to send back in late January.

### When do Amazon Black Friday deals start in 2026?

Black Friday Week runs from Thursday 19 November to Monday 30 November 2026. Deals on Amazon's own devices start earlier, on 16 November.

### Do I need Prime to get Amazon Black Friday prices?

No. Most Black Friday deals are open to everyone. Prime adds free fast delivery and members-only 'Epic Prime Deals', and new members can try it free for 30 days.

### What sells cheapest on Amazon on Black Friday?

Amazon's own devices: Kindle, Echo, Fire TV, Ring and Blink. Last year the basic Kindle fell to £69.99 and the Fire TV Stick 4K to about £25. Small kitchen appliances from Ninja and Shark are also usually cut.

### Can I return Amazon Christmas presents in January?

Last year, yes: most items bought from 1 November to 25 December 2025 could be returned until 31 January 2026. Amazon hasn't confirmed the 2026 UK dates yet.
